optimizedDescription.value: Fluent kernel builder: accumulate additive KernelOptions registries; build() ≡ createKernel.

optimizedContext.value:
# Kernel Builder

## Rules
- Public fluent composition for additive KernelOptions (storage factories, parsers, VCS, actors, external hooks). Pre-construction only — no mutate built kernel. No code-graph backend ownership.
- Fluent register: spec/schema/change/archive storage, parsers, external hooks, VCS, actors — each returns builder.
- `build()` ≡ `createKernel(config, options)`: builtins remain, externals extend, shared adapters once, immutable kernel, full `kernel.specs` use-case set (incl. metadata/optimize/deps) — no drifted second list.
- Conflicting capability names → error (no silent overwrite). Accept base registration state from resolved config.
- Reuse CompositionResolver / createKernel registry primitives — no second composition model.

## Constraints
- Composition layer only. No post-build mutation. Conflict = error.
